name: openbb_market_news
description:
Latest general market and world news through the OpenBB Platform (obb.news.world).
Returns: {articles_count, articles: [records with date, title, text, url and provider extras]} or {error}.
Inputs (* required): limit (1-50; default 10); provider (schema enum benzinga, fmp, biztoc; default benzinga). OpenBB 4.6 accepts benzinga, fmp, intrinio and tiingo, all of which need a key; biztoc is not available.
News about one company: openbb_company_news or yf_news. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"limit": 10, "provider": "fmp"}
